-Brand new tunes for each track, making the cars feel a lot more enjoyable to drive
-Improvements to the non-vision lag system, bringing input lag even lower while taking up less resources

Welcome to Next Car Racing! Race, drive, and explore some of the most popular tracks in NASCAR! Race laps against other players, drive laps to set the fastest time, or build up laps to buy from all 40+ 2024 schemes!
